description:
Rare opportunity to purchase Edwardian elegance at Ardfoyle Cresent, this home has been sympathetically remodeled over the years to accommodate modern living while showcasing it's original archtectural features.
Originally a 7 bed with 1 bathroom, the remodeling process brought it to a substantial 5 bed with 4 bathrooms and 1 downstairs WC. The main bathroom features an original 1901 claw bath while all bathrooms feature Grohe showers ( all 4 showers newly fitted in 2021).
Ardfoyles “Cul Ard” is one of only 2,  3 storey, Edwardian homes of their unique architectural design. This beautiful home is nestled in a country setting while within walking distance of all amenities such as the newly refurbished Marina walkways and parks, a plethora of delis and shops and Cork City Centre. This leafy suburb is 15 mins from Cork Airport.
“Cul Ard” is set behind a sweeping driveway and framed by mature hedging, this attractive period home spanning approx. 2,670 sq.ft. offers a wonderful blend of character and kerb appeal.
 The striking façade features classic detailing, including decorative timberwork to the gable and a charming bay window that floods the interior with natural light.
 Approached via a generous driveway providing ample off-street parking, the property is bordered by well-maintained greenery and established planting. To the front, a beautifully kept garden with flowering shrubs creates a welcoming first impression while adding privacy and colour throughout the seasons.
The setting is peaceful and leafy, making it ideal for those seeking a home with personality, outdoor space, and strong visual appeal.

Front Garden 
There is a generous paved driveway that offers ample off street parking, the drive is neatly bordered by mature hedging and a delightful mix of greenery and seasonal color, with mature shrubs, flowering borders, and a variety of textures creating a welcoming and tranquil setting. 

Rear Garden
This beautifully maintained garden offers a private, sun-drenched escape with a spacious natural stone patio perfect for outdoor dining. 

A level lawn is bordered by mature, lush hedging and vibrant flowerbeds, including a charming patch of bluebells. 

Tucked at the far end is a practical garden shed, providing excellent storage for tools or equipment.

Ground Floor 

Entrance 		 
The front door opens onto original encaustic floor tiles, complemented by elegant Edwardian cornicing. A beautifully crafted original hardwood staircase sweeps gracefully through all three storeys and across two landings, creating a wonderful sense of flow and character throughout the home .

Drawing Room 	 			
A bright and elegant drawing room featuring a charming bay window overlooking the front garden. High ceilings, decorative cornicing, an elegant original fireplace that forms a striking focal point.

Kitchen/Dining 
Bright and beautifully presented, this kitchen combines timeless shaker-style cabinetry with warm wooden worktops and an elegant tiled backsplash. A striking Rangemaster cooker with matching extractor hood forms the centrepiece, complemented by integrated appliances and a water filtration tap providing fresh, purified drinking water. Completing the space is an impressive stainless steel sink with integrated drainer — both highly practical and a standout design feature in its own right.

The Kitchen opens seamlessly into:

Family Room 
Into a large lounge/family room, creating a superb open-plan living and entertaining space with direct access to the slate patio and private rear garden. Surrounded by mature trees, the garden enjoys a peaceful, bird sanctuary atmosphere.
The spacious reception area highlights a striking vaulted ceiling with twin skylights that flood the room with natural light. French doors open onto the garden, while tall sash windows provide an attractive outlook. An original fireplace, elegant neutral décor, and generous proportions complete this warm and inviting living space.
